findings.title: Scope of Work Defined
findings.rationale: The evidence clearly outlines the scope of services to be provided under the agreement, detailing the responsibilities and deliverables of the Vendor.
evidence_excerpts: The scope of services covered under this Agreement encompasses the comprehensive supply, delivery, installation, commissioning, maintenance, and long-term operational support of the Vendor’s hardware products for the Client’s BFSI operational ecosystem.

findings.title: Vendor's Service Level Commitments
findings.rationale: The evidence specifies the Vendor's commitments regarding service levels, including incident response times and resolution timelines based on severity.
evidence_excerpts: The Vendor commits to resolving Critical incidents within four hours, High severity incidents within eight hours, Medium severity incidents within one business day, and Low severity incidents within seventy-two hours.

findings.title: Service Level Agreement Remedies
findings.rationale: The contract specifies that continued failure to meet SLA commitments may result in service credits or financial penalties as detailed in the Rate Card or annexures.
evidence_excerpts: Continued failure to meet SLA commitments may result in service credits or financial penalties as detailed in the Rate Card or annexures.

findings.title: Client Payment Obligations
findings.rationale: The evidence outlines the obligations of the Client regarding payment terms, which are critical for the Vendor's performance.
evidence_excerpts: The Client shall make payments within forty-five (45) days from the date of receipt of the completed invoice, subject to validation and reconciliation.

findings.title: Service Performance Measurement and Reporting
findings.rationale: The contract specifies that the Vendor shall furnish weekly and monthly performance reports summarizing incidents, resolutions, SLA compliance, bottlenecks, and recommendations for improvement.
evidence_excerpts: The Vendor shall furnish weekly and monthly performance reports summarizing incidents, resolutions, SLA compliance, bottlenecks, and recommendations for improvement.

findings.title: Payment Terms and Schedule
findings.rationale: The payment terms specify that the Client shall make payments within forty-five (45) days from the date of receipt of the completed invoice, and any disputed component of an invoice must be notified within seven (7) days.
evidence_excerpts: The Client shall make payments within forty-five (45) days from the date of receipt of the completed invoice, subject to validation and reconciliation.

findings.title: Late Payment Penalty Details
findings.rationale: The contract specifies that delays in invoice settlement beyond the stipulated period will incur an interest charge.
evidence_excerpts: Delay in invoice settlement beyond the stipulated period shall attract an interest charge of one percent (1%) per month until full payment is made.

findings.title: Pricing Structure Defined
findings.rationale: The evidence clearly outlines the pricing structure and billing terms applicable to the agreement, including references to a Rate Card and specific payment terms.
evidence_excerpts: All pricing applicable to this Agreement shall be governed by the Rate Card or the individual SOWs executed between the Parties.

findings.title: Cap on Financial Exposure
findings.rationale: The contract specifies a limitation on liability, capping the total cumulative liability of each party under the agreement.
evidence_excerpts: each Party’s total cumulative liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the total amount paid by the Client to the Vendor in the preceding twelve (12) months.

findings.title: Limitation of Liability Found
findings.rationale: The contract explicitly states a cap on total liability, limiting it to the total amount paid by the Client to the Vendor in the preceding twelve months, except for certain breaches.
evidence_excerpts: Except for breaches involving confidentiality, intellectual property misuse, or acts of gross negligence or willful misconduct, each Party’s total cumulative liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the total amount paid by the Client to the Vendor in the preceding twelve (12) months.

findings.title: Indemnification Obligations
findings.rationale: The evidence clearly outlines the indemnification obligations of both parties under the agreement, specifying the conditions under which each party agrees to indemnify the other.
evidence_excerpts: The Vendor agrees to indemnify and defend the Client against any third-party claims, damages, losses, liabilities, or expenses arising from product defects, workmanship deficiencies, or bodily injury caused solely by the Vendor’s Hardware Products when used as intended. The Client agrees to indemnify the Vendor against claims arising from improper handling, misuse, alteration of devices, or any actions taken by the Client that deviate from the operational guidelines provided by the Vendor.

findings.title: Termination for Cause Conditions
findings.rationale: The contract specifies that either party may terminate the agreement for cause if there is a material breach that is not cured within 30 days of written notice. Specific situations constituting cause include persistent failure to meet service obligations, non-payment, misconduct, breach of confidentiality, or non-compliance with laws.
evidence_excerpts: This Agreement may also be terminated for cause if either Party materially breaches its obligations and fails to cure such breach within a period of thirty (30) days from the receipt of a written notice specifying the nature of the breach. Situations constituting cause shall include, but are not limited to, persistent failure to meet service obligations, non-payment for delivered services or hardware, misconduct, breach of confidentiality, or non-compliance with applicable laws or industry regulations.

findings.title: Termination for Convenience Notice Period
findings.rationale: The contract specifies the notice period required for termination without cause.
evidence_excerpts: Either Party may terminate this Agreement for convenience by providing the other Party with not less than ninety (90) days’ prior written notice without the need to furnish any justification for such termination.

findings.title: Confidentiality Obligations Survival Period
findings.rationale: The evidence explicitly states the duration for which confidentiality obligations survive after the agreement ends.
evidence_excerpts: The confidentiality obligations shall survive for five (5) years following the termination of this Agreement.

findings.title: Intellectual Property Ownership
findings.rationale: The evidence clearly states that all intellectual property rights associated with the Vendor’s products remain the exclusive property of the Vendor, and the Client is granted a limited license to use the firmware and software.
evidence_excerpts: All intellectual property rights, including copyrights, patents, trademarks, trade secrets, firmware binaries, source code, configuration files, PCB layouts, circuit diagrams, and proprietary design elements associated with the Vendor’s Hardware Products and Services shall remain the exclusive property of the Vendor.

findings.title: Governing Law and Dispute Resolution
findings.rationale: The evidence clearly outlines the governing law and the method for resolving disputes, specifying arbitration as the resolution method and the applicable jurisdiction.
evidence_excerpts: This Agreement shall be governed by and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the jurisdiction specified in the SOW. Any dispute, controversy, or claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall be resolved through arbitration conducted by a panel of three arbitrators in accordance with the governing arbitration rules.
